title: apm-go Codex marketplace.json (.agents/plugins/marketplace.json)
description: Self-authored schema for apm-go's own CodexMapper output (internal/marketplace/build/codexmapper.go). A materially different shape from the Claude document -- no owner/description/version/metadata, and category is required (CategoryRequiredError). source.source can be "url" even when its "url" value is actually an owner/repo shorthand rather than a real URL on the default host -- a deliberate upstream-aligned quirk (see .trellis/spec/conformance/agent-schema.md). remoteSource is split into per-variant oneOf branches (url / git-subdir) whose required fields are read directly off composeCodexSource (codexmapper.go:129-155): both variants always set url, and git-subdir additionally always sets path. Neither branch declares 'repo': composeCodexSource never sets RemoteSource.Repo in either branch (unlike Claude's composeRemoteSource, which has a dedicated github/repo variant) -- this is a Go-only field (schema_sync_test.go's TestSchemaDrift_GoTypesMatchSchemaProperties/RemoteSource(codex) documents it via an explicit goOnlyAllowed whitelist, not a schema-declared-but-unused property), and a document with 'repo' present on either codex remoteSource branch is rejected by additionalProperties:false.

policy.description: codexmapper.go:103: every plugin gets this exact fixed pair, never derived from input.

remoteSourceUrl.description: composeCodexSource's plain-url variant (codexmapper.go:144-146): source/url are always both set (url falls back to pkg.SourceRepo verbatim on the default host -- the AS2 shorthand quirk -- but the KEY is always present).

remoteSourceGitSubdir.description: composeCodexSource's git-subdir variant (codexmapper.go:141-143): source/url/path are always all three set.
